_meta.description: Court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE FIRST CLASS
jurisdictionNote: Tries offences punishable with imprisonment up to 3 years. For bail, handles bailable offences and first-instance non-bailable bail applications under S.480 BNSS.

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the applicant/accused shall ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby verify that the contents of the above application are true and correct to my knowledge and belief.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: All applications to be filed with index and pagination.
Vakalatnama to be filed at the first instance.
Certified copy of FIR to be attached with bail applications.
Bail application to mention the date of arrest and total custody period.
